about: Lane ZM: every text field (input of a text-like type, select, textarea, contenteditable) on the shop, the owner app and the admin, measured by tools/zm-measure.cjs against tools/zm-preview.sh. touch = iPhone 390, isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 3; laptop = 1280, mouse. Each row: field, computed font-size px before -> after, box height before -> after (null when hidden), visualViewport.scale after focusing it (null when not focusable/visible).
